artifact_source_parity: Every Python runtime member matched frozen source, installed wheel and delivered checkout. Timed server imports resolved into installed site-packages; legacy control adapter adds identity reporting only.
scope_limits: The owner-lifetime race has a deterministic red/green regression, but these timings do not establish a performance pass.
29 trials meet exact-response/zero-reported-transport-error/source/mode validity; two complete records have timeout counters and one aborted client has unknown response totals.
The Linux wrk2 HDR assertion does not establish a server or clock root cause. All original invalid records and counters remain retained.
Neither a later favorable recheck nor valid no-GIL state replaces any losing scheduled-latency or capacity record.
Shared-host macOS and Ubuntu ARM64 Docker loopback, not bare-metal or separate-host/soak qualification.
